author: ValWood
body: * **PTHR ID & PTN node:** GO:0005829 | cytosol | IBA with P49591 , PTN000207087 * **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):** https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC25B8.06c mitochondrial serine-tRNA ligase dia4 * **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue** Another tricky one. In fission yeast, this is the mitochondrial tRNA ligase. The cytosolic one is https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC29A4.15 (srs1) Although this particular orthologous group does appear to be mitochondria in all species so I think they should be separable: * Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PTN000207087 mitochondrial not cytosolic

author: marcfeuermann
body: I corrected it. It was pretty easy. Cytosolic and mitochondrial proteins are well separated in the tree in two distinct nodes. The term "cytosol" was wrongly associated to the root. I have the impression that they remix as soon as I turn my back ;-)
